Which of the following is true of automatic fiscal policy stabilizers?
Option A: For a given level of government spending they produce a deficit during a recession and a surplus during an expansion.
Option B: They serve to prolong recessionary and inflationary periods.
Option C: The regressive tax system is a fundamental component of automatic stabilizers.
Option D: For a given level of government spending they produce a surplus during a recession and a surplus during an expansion.
